messages:
nina-peopleops: Micah just asked about timing: their STEM EAD expires 6/30 and we submitted an H-1B COS request. Theyhave a conf trip 6/20-6/27 and wonder if travel will break the cap-gap/COS. Also asking about benefits eligibility if start overlaps with EAD gap.

omar-immigration: Short answer: travel while a COS is pending is risky. If you leave the US during adjudication the COS can be considered abandoned and you'll need consular processing. For cap-gap: if your STEM extension keeps you work-authorized through 6/30, the H-1B COS filing (if selected) may provide cap-gap only if timely filed. Traveling during that window can interrupt the extension. 

micah-newhire: Oh wow. So if I fly 6/20 I might be forced to get a visa stamp and could miss start or have longer delays?

omar-immigration: Exactly. Consular processing timelines are unpredictable; administrative processing can add weeks. If you must attend the conf, consider postponing travel or switching to remote presentation. If unavoidable, we can prepare a travel packet (offer letter, pending COS receipt copies) but it's not a guarantee.

kevin-payroll: From payroll side: we need a valid work authorization for active payroll. If EAD lapses before H-1B COS approval and you are out of status, payroll cannot pay you. If COS is pending and youre still authorized via STEM EAD, we can process as usual. Please DM payroll copies of EAD receipt and H-1B filing confirmation so we can flag your file.

tara-benefits: Benefits enrollment window is 30 days from start. If travel causes you to miss start and enrollment window, we can request a benefits exception but need advance notice. Medical coverage typically cannot be backdated before your documented eligibility date. Upload any EAD/H-1B receipts to the portal now so benefits can tentatively queue your enrollment.

nina-peopleops: Micah, do you have the H-1B receipt number yet? If yes, drop it here or DM. We'll check filing date for cap-gap applicability and coordinate with Omar.

micah-newhire: I got the filing confirmation yesterday. Receipt number is WAC1234567890. I really want to go to the conference but don't want to risk start date.

omar-immigration: We'll check whether your H-1B petition was a change-of-status or consular processing. If itwas filed as COS and timely, cap-gap might extend status until 10/1 if petition selected. But again, leaving the country usually voids COS. I'll confirm with our attorney and post the guidance here within 24h.

kevin-payroll: Also note: if you travel and must re-enter on a stamped H-1B, payroll needs copies of the visa stamp and new I-94 before the next pay run. That can delay your first paycheck depending on timing.

micah-newhire: Understood. If I cancel travel and stay, will you still process benefits if my EAD expires 6/30 and H-1B pending?

tara-benefits: If you are in a cap-gap extension or show an unexpired EAD through the effective start date, we can enroll you. If there's a gap in authorization, we need the authorization date to be valid on your start. Upload the EAD card front/back and the H-1B receipt to the portal; we'll pre-enroll pending final docs.

hr-bot: Reminder set: "Verify Micah EAD + H-1B receipts" in 48h.

nina-peopleops: Thanks all. Micah please DM the receipt and passport scan. Omar will follow up with attorney note about travel risk. If you decide to travel, well draft a short letter for consulate with employment details but can't guarantee outcome.

micah-newhire: DMing receipts now. Appreciate the quick help 44b

omar-immigration: Received DM. I'll loop in counsel and post final travel recommendation by end of day tomorrow.

nina-peopleops: Great closing loop we'll pause any travel reimbursements until status confirmed. Keep us posted and don't finalize travel until we advise.
